title: Ghislaine Maxwell's Swedish male aides and collected hair
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Ghislaine Maxwell's Swedish male aides and collected hair, about unspecified at Ghislaine Maxwell's Upper East Side townhouse, Manhattan, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Ghislaine Maxwell's Upper East Side townhouse, Manhattan

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani, speaking on a podcast, says that Ghislaine Maxwell, a British socialite, had live-in male aides from Sweden at her townhouse on Manhattan's Upper East Side. He bases this on an article by one former aide, which he discussed in a piece on his own newsletter, and the story as told says these aides collected hair, though no date is given. Told this way, it hints at some hidden purpose behind her household.
